title: Spanish royals make sensitive official visit to sensitive Ceuta enclave
summary: Cheering crowds waving Spanish flags filled Ceuta on Tuesday as King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia made a diplomatically sensitive visit to the city following July's migrant influx from Morocco.
